title: A sufficient home beyond shared attachment

captions.physics: Maintaining familiar comfort at freedom’s expense
captions.emotions: Feeling wholeness in available shared life

meaning: Your domestic support keeps its wholeness when a ready home permits free review of the familiar instead of identical attachment to every object proving shared participation.
text: The Devil in the physical position of Muladhara describes domestic actions maintaining familiar comfort even at the cost of free choice. The Lovers in energy intensify them through demanding identical wishes. The World in emotions wants wholeness and sufficiency at home. Readiness can depend on an excessively strict condition: both must value the entire familiar quantity equally. One person’s inconvenience supposedly means the shared home is insufficiently real although sufficient life together needs no complete sameness in every material attachment.

For example, a full furniture set remains for a rarely practised home activity. One wants the room freed, but shared space seems to lose meaning without the objects. **Wholeness at home does not require identically retaining every earlier possibility.** You can recognise shared experience and choose present convenience. Support returns to both instead of ready life awaiting completely matching attitudes to everything once helping imagine it beautiful, sufficient and shared.

The difficulty is considering reduction rejection of togetherness itself. Outward agreement stays while free use becomes harder. Distinguishing wholeness from an unchanged collection offers more dependable support: space can remain yours after reduction. Support grows through changing material form without testing closeness or granting each previous detail indefinite entitlement to represent all shared life’s value. The home’s meaning can continue without preserving its entire earlier inventory.
